satellites.title: Wood as a Phase
satellites.evidence: In 洪範, 木 is third in the sequence of five phases; it belongs to a traditional ordering, not a scientific periodic table.
satellites.caveat: A correspondence internal to a historical system; not a statement about natural science.

satellites.title: Spring’s Virtue Is in Wood
satellites.evidence: The Yueling chapter of the Liji files each season under a phase. At the start of spring the announcement is 盛德在木, “the abundant virtue is in Wood”, and the same month takes the sour taste, scaled creatures and the note jue.
satellites.caveat: A correspondence within a calendrical system; Baracus’s, from general knowledge.
